ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2023 Lamborghini Urus S for sale!

Powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 producing 657 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque, the Urus S delivers breathtaking acceleration with a 0–62 mph time of just 3.5 seconds and a top speed of 190 mph. Its permanent all-wheel-drive system, four-wheel steering, torque-vectoring technology, and adaptive air suspension give the Urus S remarkable agility and confidence while maintaining the versatility expected from a luxury SUV. The aggressive front fascia, sculpted bodywork, sharp LED lighting, and signature Lamborghini proportions create an unmistakable presence whether cruising through Miami or arriving at an exclusive destination. Inside, the cabin blends Italian craftsmanship with premium materials, advanced technology, and a distinctly performance-oriented atmosphere for both driver and passengers. With the ability to deliver supercar-level performance while offering four-door practicality and everyday usability, the Urus S represents one of Lamborghinis most versatile expressions of performance.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Urus S yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
